reportTitle: IRP AND REG S-P READINESS REPORT
disclaimer: This assessment is for training and readiness purposes only. It is not legal advice and is not a determination of regulatory compliance.

csirt: File this report in the firm's compliance records as evidence of IRP training and readiness review.
Review every missed question with the CSIRT, using the IRP section listed for each.
Close the readiness gaps, starting with the lowest-scoring section.
Bring this report to the annual IRP review with AdvisorDefense to measure progress.
staff: Give this report to the Chief Compliance Officer for the firm's compliance records.
Reread Appendix E of the IRP, the Supervised Person FAQ, for any question you missed.
Save the CSIRT contact details from Appendix D where you can find them quickly.
If you are ever unsure whether something is an incident, report it to the CSIRT.
